headline: Gannon keep winning and still have a match to play
dek: Gannon won at home again and now have fifteen wins, three draws and three defeats across all their matches. No other programme in the conference has won as often.
displaced_by: Gannon's home win took their record to fifteen wins, so the standing dek's fourteen was no longer true.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Gannon have scored more than California (Pa.), Shippensburg and Pitt-Johnstown together but conceded 25, so theirs is a lead in goals scored, not in goals kept out.

wire.line: Lock Haven, West Chester and Millersville finish level on points behind Gannon at the top.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's home match against District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pitt-Johnstown have conceded 48 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, and have won one match, drawn two and lost thirteen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lock Haven have drawn nine matches, more than any other programme in the conference, against six wins and four defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jaden Howard has kept eight shutouts in goal for West Chester.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rafael Santos has six goals and eight assists from 56 shots for Seton Hill.

last_match.line: Gannon's first match against a side from outside the conference since the middle of September.

next_match.line: Gannon have lost away from home only at Lock Haven.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
